map.ISTH 显性 DIC 评分系统，基于血小板、D-二聚体/FDP、PT、纤维蛋白: The ISTH overt DIC scoring system, based on platelets, D-dimer/FDP, PT and fibrinogen to assess disseminated intravascular coagulation
map.用 ISTH 显性 DIC 评分（血小板/D-二聚体/PT/纤维蛋白原）判 DI: Use the ISTH overt DIC score (platelets / D-dimer / PT / fibrinogen) to judge DIC

map.≥5 显性 DIC 启动替代+抗凝，<5 非显性动态复查: >=5 overt DIC starts replacement plus anticoagulation; <5 non-overt DIC is rechecked dynamically
map.：ISTH 评分：血小板<50(+2)、50–100(+1)；D-二聚体>10(: ISTH score: platelets < 50 (+2), 50-100 (+1); D-dimer > 10 (+3), 5-10 (+2), > 1 (+1); PT prolongation > 6s (+2), 3-6s (+1); fibrinogen < 1.0 (+1). There must be an underlying disease causing DIC; >= 5 is overt DIC, < 5 is non-overt. Supplement: a positive 3P test indicates soluble fibrin monomers (SFMC), and elevated FDP supports hyperfibrinolysis.
map.：例（血小板=45、D-二聚体=8.5、PT 延长=5s、纤维蛋白原=0.9）：: Example (platelets=45, D-dimer=8.5, PT prolongation=5s, fibrinogen=0.9): platelets < 50 (+2), D-dimer 5-10 (+2), PT 3-6s (+1), fibrinogen < 1.0 (+1) -> ISTH = 6 points -> overt DIC, requiring treatment of the underlying disease plus platelets, cryoprecipitate or FFP, and anticoagulation if needed.
map.3P 试验阳性一定 DIC 吗？: Does a Positive 3P Test Always Mean DIC?
map.不一定。3P 阳性提示存在可溶性纤维蛋白单体，支持 DIC 但敏感性与特异性有限: Not always. A positive 3P test indicates soluble fibrin monomers and supports DIC, but its sensitivity and specificity are limited; advanced fibrinolysis or a specimen left too long can give false negatives or positives, so combine it with the ISTH score and the clinical picture.
map.纤维蛋白原「正常」能排除 DIC 吗？: Can a "Normal" Fibrinogen Rule Out DIC?
map.不能。DIC 早期纤维蛋白原可因肝病/炎症升高而掩盖；动态下降或持续<1.0 g: No. In early DIC fibrinogen can be raised by liver disease or inflammation and mask the change; a dynamic decline or a persistent value below 1.0 g/L is more meaningful, so recheck and follow the D-dimer trend.
